info.title: BonID Open Identity & Partner API
info.description:
The BonID API provides secure digital identity verification, citizen consent flows,
crime status checks, and certificate verification for partners in Haiti.

---

### Authentication

| Method | Header | Used By |
|--------|--------|---------|
| **API Key** | `X-Partner-Api-Key` | All partner endpoints |
| **Bearer Token** | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` | OAuth-protected endpoints |
| **Dual Auth** | Both API Key + Bearer | Identity, Crime, Certificates |

### Rate Limits
Rate limit headers are returned on applicable endpoints:
`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`

parameters.description:
Transaction consent token (from POST /transaction_consents).
**Double-Lock flow:** Without this token, the response only contains
verification status (verified: true/false) — no personal data.
With a valid, approved consent_token, the response includes identity
data filtered to the consented scopes only.

post.description:
Request citizen consent for a specific transaction. The citizen receives a
6-digit OTP via email (and SMS if phone is on file) and must approve via the
decide endpoint. Provide a `callback_url` to receive the result via webhook.

---

### How It Works

1. **Partner creates** a consent request with the citizen's BonID, transaction type, and optional amount.
2. **Citizen receives** a 6-digit OTP via email (and SMS if phone is on file), plus a real-time push notification in their BonID dashboard.
3. **Citizen decides** — approves (with OTP or face liveness) or denies via `POST /transaction_consents/{token}/decide`.
4. **Partner receives** the result via webhook callback to your `callback_url`, including an HMAC-SHA256 signature for non-repudiation.

---

### Transaction Types & TTLs

Each type has a time-to-live (TTL). Shorter TTLs reduce fraud windows.

| Category | Type | TTL | Use Case |
|----------|------|-----|----------|
| **Financial** | `account_opening` | 15 min | Open a new bank or fintech account |
| | `wire_transfer` | 5 min | Domestic or international wire transfer |
| | `p2p_transfer` | 5 min | Person-to-person mobile money send |
| | `remittance` | 10 min | Diaspora remittance (Western Union, CAM, etc.) |
| | `bill_payment` | 5 min | Utility bills, tuition, rent |
| | `merchant_payment` | 5 min | Purchase at a merchant or point of sale |
| | `cash_out` | 5 min | Agent-based mobile money withdrawal |
| | `cash_in` | 5 min | Agent-based deposit |
| | `mobile_topup` | 5 min | Phone credit recharge |
| | `loan_application` | 15 min | Microfinance or bank loan identity check |
| **Identity** | `kyc_check` | 10 min | Know Your Customer verification |
| | `balance_inquiry` | 5 min | Confirm account ownership |
| | `age_verification` | 10 min | Confirm citizen is 18+ |
| **Documents** | `card_issuance` | 15 min | Issue a debit or credit card |
| | `insurance_claim` | 15 min | Verify claimant identity |
| | `document_signing` | 15 min | Digitally sign a document |
| **Government (Haiti)** | `civil_registry` | 15 min | Archives Nationales — birth, marriage, death certificates |
| | `tax_service` | 15 min | DGI — Matricule Fiscale, property taxes |
| | `identity_issuance` | 15 min | ONI / Passport — CIN renewal, passport status |
| | `land_registry` | 15 min | ONACA — property ownership verification |
| | `voter_status` | 10 min | CEP — voter identity verification |
| | `judicial_record` | 15 min | Tribunals — Casier Judiciaire (police record) |
| **Crypto / Blockchain** | `crypto_buy` | 5 min | Fiat-to-crypto on-ramp — full KYC + source of funds |
| | `crypto_sell` | 5 min | Crypto-to-fiat off-ramp — AML reporting required |
| | `crypto_transfer` | 10 min | Peer-to-peer on-chain — Travel Rule for > $1000 |
| | `crypto_swap` | 10 min | Token-to-token exchange — no fiat, lower risk |
| | `crypto_kyc` | 30 min | Exchange onboarding — enhanced due diligence (EDD) |

---

### Webhook Callbacks

When a citizen decides, BonID sends a `POST` to your `callback_url`:

**Headers:** `Content-Type: application/json` and `X-BonID-Event: transaction_consent.approved` (or `.denied`, `.expired`)

**Payload:**
```json
{
  "consent_token": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "bonid": "JM-1968-M-OUEST-P2334-217",
  "transaction_type": "wire_transfer",
  "status": "approved",
  "reference_id": "txn_12345",
  "amount": "5000.00",
  "currency": "HTG",
  "signature": "a8f3b2c1d4e5...",
  "decided_at": "2026-03-17T15:33:00Z",
  "expires_at": "2026-03-17T15:35:00Z",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-17T15:33:01Z"
}
```

**Retry policy:** 3 retries with exponential backoff (2 s, 4 s, 8 s).

---

### Signature Verification (HMAC-SHA256)

The `signature` field provides non-repudiation — cryptographic proof the citizen approved.

1. Reconstruct the proof: `{ consent_token, bonid, partner_id, transaction_type, reference_id, amount, currency, status, decided_at, scopes }`
2. Compute `HMAC-SHA256(proof_json, your_api_key_digest)`
3. Compare with the `signature` field — match = authentic.

bonid.description: The citizen's BonID or BonTouris ID.

scopes.description:
Permission scopes to request. Common scopes:
`identity:verify`, `identity:details`, `crime:status`, `crime:reports`, `crime:certificate`.

amount.description: Transaction amount. Optional for non-financial types like `kyc_check` or `age_verification`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to `HTG` if omitted.

description.description: Human-readable description shown to the citizen in the OTP email and dashboard.

reference_id.description:
Your internal transaction reference. Must be unique per citizen + partner pair.
Use this to correlate BonID consent with your internal records.

callback_url.description:
Webhook URL where BonID will POST the consent decision (approved, denied, or expired).
See the tag description above for the full webhook payload format.

201.description: Consent request created and OTP sent to citizen

consent_token.description: Unique token to track this consent. Use it with GET and decide endpoints.

expires_at.description: When this consent expires (based on transaction type TTL).

example.message: Consent request sent to citizen. Awaiting approval.

404.description: Citizen not found for provided BonID

422.description:
Validation error. Possible causes:
- Invalid `transaction_type` (not in the allowed enum)
- Missing `scopes` array
- Duplicate `reference_id` (already used for this citizen + partner)

Check the current status of a consent request. Use this to poll for results

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP code sent to the citizen's email/phone.

Checks if the authenticated voter is on the CEP voter roll and hasn't voted yet.
Returns a challenge nonce for the Schnorr ZKP proof.
Includes geolocation validation (BonID country code vs IP country).

403.description: Not eligible (already voted, not on roll, or unverified BonID)

example.message: Ou deja vote nan eleksyon sa a.

post.description:
Casts an encrypted vote with ZKP proof. The server NEVER sees the vote choice —
only the encrypted payload that only the CEP can decrypt after multi-sig ceremony.

**Idempotent**: If the same nullifier is sent twice (e.g., network retry),
the server returns the existing receipt without double-counting.

**Payload must be < 1KB** for 2G/3G network compatibility.

nullifier.description: HMAC-SHA256 nullifier — deterministic per voter+election. Prevents double-voting.

encrypted_choice.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted vote choice. Only CEP's private key can decrypt.

zkp_commitment.description: Pedersen commitment — hides the vote choice cryptographically.

zkp_proof.description: Schnorr NIZK proof of voter eligibility without revealing identity.

liveness_session_id.description: AWS Rekognition liveness session ID from biometric verification.

get.description:
Public endpoint — no authentication required.
Allows any person to verify a ballot hash exists in the public ledger.
Powers the "Vòt ou konte" (Your vote counts) verification page.
No PII is exposed — only the hash, timestamp, and ledger position.

200.description: Ballot found in the public ledger

post.description:
Called once when a tablet is set up at a consulate on election day.
GPS coordinates are verified against registered consulate locations.
Returns a kiosk session token valid for 18 hours.

post.summary: Scan voter BonID at consulate kiosk
post.description:
Scans a voter's BonID QR code at the kiosk. Returns masked voter info
and eligibility status. Issues a short-lived voter token (15 min)
for the biometric verification + voting flow.

200.description: Voter eligible — proceed to biometric verification

404.description: BonID not found or not verified

voterToken.name: X-BonID-Voter-Token
voterToken.description:
Signed biometric session token issued after liveness + face match.
Expires in 15 minutes. Proves the voter is biometrically verified.

appAttestation.name: X-BonID-Attestation
appAttestation.description:
HMAC-SHA256 app attestation proving the request comes from a genuine BonID app.
Must include X-BonID-Timestamp and X-BonID-Device headers.
Timestamp must be within 5 minutes (anti-replay).

kioskSecret.name: X-BonID-Kiosk-Secret
kioskSecret.description: Consulate kiosk registration secret. Used only during station setup.

kioskToken.name: X-BonID-Kiosk-Token
kioskToken.description: Signed kiosk session token. Valid for 18 hours (election day).

biometrics.description:
Raw biometric confidence scores for partner risk engines.
Partners can apply their own thresholds (e.g., bank processing $10k
transfer requires liveness_confidence > 90; NGO distributing aid
accepts > 70).

face_match_threshold.description: Minimum similarity BonID required for a match

verified_with_review.description: True if liveness was in gray zone (65-74%) and a human admin approved

biometrics_reused.description: True if liveness was carried forward from a prior submission (doc-only resubmit)

TransactionType.description:
The type of transaction. Determines the consent TTL (time-to-live).
Financial transactions use shorter TTLs (5 min) to limit fraud windows.
Document and service transactions use longer TTLs (15 min).

ConsentStatus.description: Current state of a transaction consent.

ConsentSummary.description:
Full consent record returned by GET and decide endpoints.
The `signature` field is only present after the citizen has made a decision.

signature.description:
HMAC-SHA256 non-repudiation signature. Present only after citizen decides.
Verify this against your API key digest to confirm authenticity.

decided_at.description: When the citizen approved or denied. Null if still pending.

expires_at.description: When this consent expires based on the transaction type TTL.

created_at.description: When the consent request was created.

WebhookPayload.description:
Payload sent to your `callback_url` when a consent decision is made.
Delivered as a POST with header `X-BonID-Event: transaction_consent.{status}`.
Retried 3 times with exponential backoff (2 s, 4 s, 8 s) on failure.

status.description: The citizen's decision (or `expired` if TTL exceeded).

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 non-repudiation proof. Verify with your API key digest.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 country code from voter's BonID

challenge_nonce.description: Random nonce for Schnorr ZKP proof generation

location.description: Geolocation validation — BonID country vs IP country

flagged.description: true if location mismatch detected (logged for CEP review)

nullifier.description: HMAC-SHA256 — deterministic per voter+election. Same person = same nullifier = rejected on retry.

zkp_commitment.description: Pedersen commitment — cryptographically hides the vote choice

liveness_session_id.description: AWS Rekognition liveness session from biometric verification

biometric_hash.description: SHA256 hash of face comparison result

EncryptedChoice.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted vote. Only the CEP's private key can decrypt.

encrypted_key.description: AES key encrypted with CEP's RSA public key

SchnorrProof.description: Non-Interactive Zero-Knowledge proof of voter eligibility without revealing identity

response.description: Schnorr response proving knowledge of private key

public_commitment.description: Random public commitment for the proof

VoteCastResponse.description: Vote receipt — the voter's proof their ballot was recorded

ballot_hash.description: SHA256 hash — the voter's receipt code for public verification

source.description: Vote channel — phone app or consulate tablet

idempotent.description: true if this was a retry and the original receipt was returned

BallotVerifyResponse.description: Public ballot verification — 'Vòt ou konte' (Your vote counts)

kiosk_token.description: Signed session token valid for 18 hours (election day)

KioskScanResponse.description: Voter scan result at consulate kiosk

display.description: UI display data for kiosk screen (masked — no full PII)

voter_token.description: Short-lived token (15 min) for biometric verification + voting

BiometricVerification.description: Biometric verification details included in identity and consent responses

compared_against.description: Which document the face was compared against
